name: EpiModelCOVID
what_it_is: An R package extending EpiModel to simulate SARS-CoV-2 transmission dynamics over dynamic contact networks using temporal exponential-family random graph models (tERGM). Provides individual-based epidemic simulation for settings like cruise ships and corporate offices.
measurement: Vaccination counts by dose and age
modes: Ship module (closed passenger/crew population with lockdown switching)
Corporate module (office workforce with hospitalization and vaccination)
constraints: No spatial component; heterogeneity via network layers only
Stochastic; needs explicit seed for reproducibility
PCR sensitivity uniform; no viral-load trajectory model
Vaccination limited to two-dose; no waning or booster
Static mortality lookup; no comorbidity or ICU-capacity feedback
notable_absences: No REST API or containerised runtime
